question: If (x + 4)<sup>3</sup> + (2x + 1)<sup>3</sup> + (2x + 5)<sup>3</sup> = (3x + 12) (2x + 1) (2x + 5), then what is the value of x?

question: A shopkeeper sold two articles for Rs. 9639 each. On one, he gained 19% and on the other, he lost 19%. What is the overall percentage gain or loss?
question_hi: एक दुकानदार दो वस्तुओं को प्रति 9639 रुपए की दर से बेचता है। एक वस्तु पर वह 19% लाभ प्राप्त करता है और दूसरी वस्तु पर उसे 19% का हानि होता है। उसका कुल लाभ/हानि प्रतिशत क्या है?
solution:
Cost price of one article = (9639 × 100)/119 = Rs.8100

Cost price of other article = (9639 × 100)/81 = Rs.11900

Total cost price of two articles = 8100 + 11900 = Rs.20000

Total selling price of two articles = 2 × 9639 = Rs.19278

Loss percentage = (20000 – 19278)/(20000) × 100 = 3.61%

Loss of 3.61%.

question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 12 hours and 16 hours respectively and pipe C can empty the full tank in 24 hours. All three pipes are opened together, but after 4 hours pipe A is closed. In how many hours from the beginning the tank be filled?
question_hi: पाइप A और B क्रमशः 12 घंटे और 16 घंटे में एक टंकी को भर सकते हैं और पाइप C, 24 घंटे में पूर्ण टंकी को रिक्त कर सकता है। तीनों पाइप एक साथ चालू किये जाते हैं, लेकिन 4 घंटे के बाद पाइप A बंद कर दिया जाता है। प्रारम्भ से कितने घंटे में टंकी भर जायेगी?
solution:
Pipe A's 1 hour's work = 1/12

Pipe B's 1 hour's work = 1/16

Pipe C's 1 hour's work = 1/24

Pipe (A + B + C)’s 1 hour work = 1/12 + 1/16 – 1/24 = 5/48

Pipe(A + B + C)’s 4 hours work = 5/12

Remaining work = 1 – 5/12 = 7/12

Pipe(B + C)’s 1 hour's work = 1/16 – 1/24 = 1/48

Time taken by B and C = 7/12 × 48 = 28 hours

Total hours = 28 + 4 = 32 hours

question: If a train runs with the speed of 36 km/h, it reaches its destination 15 minutes late. However, if its speed is 45 km/h, it is late by only 4 minutes. The correct time to cover its journey in minutes is∶
question_hi: यदि एक रेल 36 किमी/घंटा की गति से चलती है, तब वह अपने गंतव्य पर 15 मिनट देरी से पहुंचती है। हालांकि, यदि इसकी गति 45 किमी/घंटा है, तब यह केवल 4 मिनट की देरी से पहुंचती है। यात्रा को पूर्ण करने में लगा समय मिनटों में है∶
solution:
Given:

S1 = 36 km/h and S2 = 45 km/h

Formula Used:

Distance = (S1 × S2)/ (S2 - S1)  × Difference in time

Calculation:

Distance = (S1 × S2)/ (S2 - S1)  × Difference in time

⇒ (36 × 45)/(45 - 36) × (15 - 4)/60          (We have divided by 60 to convert minutes into hours)

⇒ (36 × 45)/9 × 11/60

⇒ 33 km     

NOTE: 33 is the distance between the two places and not the time.

To find the distance, 

⇒ 33/36 - 15 minutes

⇒ 11/12 - 15 minutes

⇒ 55 minutes - 15 minutes = 40 minutes   (We can write 11/12 as 55 minutes because if we divide 60 minutes into 12 parts, then 11 parts will represent 55 minutes)
solution_hi:
माना रेल द्वारा कुल तय दूरी N किमी है और लिया गया समय M मिनट हैं

तब,

⇒ N/(M + 15) = 36

⇒ N/(M + 4) = 45

हल करने पर,

⇒ 36M + 540 = 45M + 180

⇒ M = 40

40 मिनट का समय लिया गया है।

question: The successive discounts of 20%, 10% and 8% is equivalent to a single discount of∶
question_hi: 20%, 10% और 8% की सतत छूट, एकल छूट के कितने प्रतिशत के बराबर है?
solution:
Given:

The successive discount are 20%, 10% and 8%.

Formula:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

Where,

X = First discount

Y = Second discount

Calculation:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

⇒ 20 + 10 - 200/100

⇒ 28%

Now, again

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

X = 28%, Y = 8%

⇒ 28 + 8 - (28 × 8)/100

⇒ 28 + 8 - 224/100

⇒ 36 - 2.24 = 33.76%

∴ The single equivalent discount is 33.76%.

Shortcut Trick

One equivalent discount

= 100 – (80/100 × 90/100 × 92/100 × 100) = 33.76%
solution_hi:
दिया गया है:

क्रमिक छूट 20%, 10% और 8% है।

सूत्र:

क्रमिक छूट = X + Y - (XY)/100

जहाँ,

X = पहली छूट

Y = दूसरी छूट

गणना:

क्रमिक छूट = X + Y - (XY)/100

⇒ 20 + 10 - 200/100

⇒ 28%

अब, फिर से

क्रमिक छूट = X + Y - (XY)/100

X = 28%, Y = 8%

⇒ 28 + 8 - (28 × 8)/100

⇒ 28 + 8 - 224/100

⇒ 36 - 2.24 = 33.76%

एकल समकक्ष छूट 33.76% है।

Shortcut Trick

एकल समकक्ष छूट

= 100 – (80/100 × 90/100 × 92/100 × 100) = 33.76%

question: If the income of A is 40% more than the income of B, then by what percentage is B’s income less than that income of A?

B's income is 200/7% less than A's.

question: A sphere of radius 7 cm is melted and recast into small spheres of radius 2 cm each. How many such spheres can be made?
question_hi: 7 सेमी त्रिज्या के एक गोले को पिघलाकर 2 सेमी त्रिज्या के छोटे गोले बनाये गये हैं। इस प्रकार कितने गोले बनाये जा सकते हैं?
solution:
Given:

Radius of the large sphere, R = 7 cm

Radius of the small sphere, r = 2 cm

Concept:

Volume of a sphere = (4/3)π(radius)3

Calculation:

Volume of sphere of radius of 7 cm = n × Volume of sphere of radius 2 cm

(4/3)π(7)3 = n × (4/3)π(2)3

73 = n × 23

343 = 8n

n = 343/8 

n = 42.86

∴ The number of small spheres that can be made is 42.
solution_hi:
गोले का आयतन = (4/3)πr3

बड़े गोले का आयतन = 4/3 × π × 7 × 7 × 7 = (4π/3) × 73

छोटे गोले का आयतन = (4π/3) × 23

तब, माना गोलों की संख्या B है।

⇒ (4π/3) × 73 = B × (4π/3) × 23)

⇒ B = 42

इस प्रकार 42 गोले बनाये जा सकते हैं।

question: A sum of Rs. 15,600 is invested partly at 7% per annum and the remaining at 9% per annum simple interest. If the total interest at the end of 3 years is Rs. 3,738, how much money was invested at 7% per annum?
question_hi: 15600 रुपए की धनराशी का कुछ भाग 7% वार्षिक साधारण ब्याज दर से और शेष भाग 9% वार्षिक साधारण ब्याज की दर से निवेश की जाती है। यदि 3 वर्षों में कुल ब्याज 3738 रुपए प्राप्त होता है, तब 7% वार्षिक ब्याज दर से कितनी धनराशी निवेश की गयी थी?
solution:
Let one part of income invested at 7% be Rs. A.

Other part = 15600 – A

Then,

⇒ (A × 3 × 7/100) + ((15600 – A) × 3 × 9/100) = 3738

⇒ 21A + 421200 – 27A = 373800

⇒ A = 7900

Amount invested at 7% is Rs. 7900.

question: Two pipes A and B can fill an empty tank in 10 hours and 16 hours respectively. They are opened alternately for 1 hour each, starting with pipe A first. In how many hours, the empty tank will be filled?
question_hi: दो पाइप A और B एक रिक्त टंकी को क्रमशः 10 घंटे और 16 घंटे में भर सकते हैं। उन्हें प्रत्येक 1 घंटे के लिए एकांतर क्रम में पाइप A से प्रारम्भ करके चालू किया जाता है। रिक्त टंकी कितने घंटे में भर जायेगी।
solution:
Pipe A's 1 hour's work = 1/10

Pipe B's 1 hour's work = 1/16

Pipe (A + B)’s 2 hours work = 1/10 + 1/16 = 13/80

Pipe (A + B)’ 12 hours work = 6 × 13/80 = 78/80 = 39/40

Remaining fraction of work after 12 hours = 1 – 39/40 = 1/40

This work will be done by A in = 1/40 × 10 = 1/4 hours

Total time = 12 + 1/4 = 49/4 hours = \(12\frac{1}{4}{\rm{hours}}\)
solution_hi:
पाइप A का 1 घंटे का कार्य = 1/10

पाइप B का 1 घंटे का कार्य = 1/16

पाइप (A + B) का 2 घंटे का कार्य = 1/10 + 1/16 = 13/80

पाइप (A + B) का 12 घंटे का कार्य = 6 × 13/80 = 78/80 = 39/40

12 घंटे के बाद कार्य का शेष भाग = 1 – 39/40 = 1/40

यह कार्य A द्वारा किया जायेगा = 1/40 × 10 = 1/4 घंटे में

कुल समय = 12 + 1/4 = 49/4 घंटे = \(12\frac{1}{4}\) घंटे

question: Two numbers are in the ratio 5 ∶ 11. If their HCF is 24, then the sum of two these numbers is∶

question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral such that AB is the diameter of the circle circumscribing it and ∠ADC = 155°, then what is the measure of ∠BAC?

solution:
Given,

∠ADC = 155°

ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral,

∠ADC + ∠CBA = 180°

∠CBA = 180 – 155 = 25°

As angle subtended in semicircle is 90°.

∠ACB = 90°

In ΔABC,

∠ACB + ∠CBA + ∠BAC = 180

∠BAC = 180 – (90 + 25) = 65°
solution_hi:
दिया गया है,

∠ADC = 155°

ABCD चक्रीय चतुर्भुज है,

∠ADC + ∠CBA = 180°

∠CBA = 180 – 155 = 25°

जैसे कि अर्धवृत्त में बनाया गया कोण 90° होता है।

∠ACB = 90°

ΔABC में,

∠ACB + ∠CBA + ∠BAC = 180

∠BAC = 180 – (90 + 25) = 65°

question: In an examination, 53% of the candidates failed in science and 48% failed in mathematics. If 40% failed in both subjects, what percentage passed in both subjects?

solution:

solution_hi:

= 100 – 13 – 8 – 40 = 39%

question: A shopkeeper marks an article at a price such that after giving a discount of 25%, he gains x%. If the cost price and the marked price of the article are Rs. 460 and Rs. 736 respectively. What is the value of x?

question: What is the sum of the digits of the least number, which when divided by 15, 18 and 27 leaves the same reminder 9 in each case and is also completely divisible by 11?

solution:
LCM of numbers

15 = 3 × 5

18 = 2 × 3 × 3

27 = 3 × 3 × 3

LCM = 3 × 3 × 5 × 2 × 3 = 270

The required number which is completely divisible by 11

= 270 × 4 + 9 = 1089

Sum of digits = 1 + 8 + 9 = 18
solution_hi:

= 270 × 4 + 9 = 1089

अंकों का योग = 1 + 8 + 9 = 18

question: A sum of Rs. 12,000 is invested for 15 months at 10% per annum compounded half yearly. What is the percentage gain, at the end of 15 months, correct to one decimal place?

solution:
Suppose P = Principal, R = rate of interest and N = time

Compound interest calculated half yearly = P(1 + (R/2)/100)2n – 1

Given,

Time = 1 year and 3 months

Amount = 12000(1 + 5/100)2 = 13230

Simple Interest = (13230 × 3/12 × 10)/100 = 330.75

Amount after 15 months = 13230 + 330.75 = Rs.13560.75

Percentage increase = (13560.75 – 12000) / (12000) × 100 = 13.0%

question: The efficiencies of A, B and C are in the ratio 2 ∶ 5 ∶ 7 working together, they can complete a work in 10 days. In how many days will, A alone be able to complete 30% of that work?

solution:

A alone can complete the work in = 140M/2M = 70 days

To complete 30% of work, A will take = 70 × 30/100 = 21 days
solution_hi:

कार्य के 30% भाग को केवल A पूर्ण करेगा = 70 × 30/100 = 21 दिनों में

question: A boat can go 20 km downstream and 30 km upstream in 2 hours 20 minutes. Also, it can go 10 km downstream and 8 km upstream in 49 minutes. What is the speed of boat when it goes downstream in km/h?

Time in hours = 2 + 20/60 = 7/3 hours

Solving,

Subtracting,

⇒ 14/A = 7/10

⇒ A = 20

⇒ 20/B = 7/3 – 30/20

⇒ B = 24

Speed downstream = 24 kmph
solution_hi:
समय घंटे में = 2 + 20/60 = 7/3 घंटे

समय घंटे में = 49/60 घंटे

माना प्रवाह के प्रतिकूल दिशा में गति और प्रवाह के अनुकूल दिशा में गति क्रमशः A किमी/घंटे और B किमी/घंटे है।

⇒ 8/A + 10/B = 49/60

हल करने पर,

⇒ 16/A + 20/B = 49/30      ---- (2)

घटाने पर,

question: \(\frac{6.75~\times ~6.75~\times ~6.75-4.25~\times ~4.25~\times ~4.25}{67.5~\times ~67.5~+~42.5~\times ~42.5~+~67.5~\times ~42.5}=?\)
solution:
Mistake Points

In this type of question, in the numerator, there are 6.75 and 4.25, while in the denominator there is 67.5, and 42.5 is present in multiplication.

From the denominator, we can write 67.5 × 67.5 as 6.75 × 10 × 6.75 × 10 = 100 × (6.75), and similarly for other terms.

Therefore we take 100 as common from the denominator.

Identity used:

a3 - b3 = (a - b) (a2 + b2 + ab)

Calculation:

\(\Rightarrow \text{ }\!\!~\!\!\text{ }\frac{6.75~\times ~6.75~\times ~6.75-4.25~\times ~4.25~\times ~4.25}{67.5~\times ~67.5~+~42.5~\times ~42.5~+~67.5~\times ~42.5}\)

\( \Rightarrow {\rm{}}\frac{{\left[ {\left( {6.75{\rm{\;}}-{\rm{\;}}4.25} \right)\left( {6.75{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}6.75{\rm{\;}} + {\rm{\;}}4.25{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}4.25{\rm{\;}} + {\rm{\;}}6.75{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}4.25} \right)} \right]}}{{[100{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}\left( {6.75{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}6.75{\rm{\;}} + {\rm{\;}}4.25{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}4.25{\rm{\;}} + {\rm{\;}}6.75{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}4.25} \right)}}\)

⇒ ? = 2.5/100

⇒ ? = 0.025

∴ ? = 0.025
solution_hi:
Mistake Points

इस प्रकार के प्रश्न में, अंश में 6.75 और 4.25 है, जबकि हर में 67.5 और 42.5 गुणन में मौजूद हैं।

हर से, हम 67.5 × 67.5 को 6.75 × 10 × 6.75 × 10 = 100 × (6.75) के रूप में लिख सकते हैं, और इसी तरह अन्य पदों को भी लिख सकते हैं।

इसलिए हम हर से 100 को उभयनिष्ठ मानते हैं।

प्रयुक्त सर्वसमिका:

a3 - b3 = (a - b) (a2 + b2 + ab)

गणना:

\(\Rightarrow \text{ }\!\!~\!\!\text{ }\frac{6.75~\times ~6.75~\times ~6.75-4.25~\times ~4.25~\times ~4.25}{67.5~\times ~67.5~+~42.5~\times ~42.5~+~67.5~\times ~42.5}\)

\( \Rightarrow {\rm{}}\frac{{\left[ {\left( {6.75{\rm{\;}}-{\rm{\;}}4.25} \right)\left( {6.75{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}6.75{\rm{\;}} + {\rm{\;}}4.25{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}4.25{\rm{\;}} + {\rm{\;}}6.75{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}4.25} \right)} \right]}}{{[100{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}\left( {6.75{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}6.75{\rm{\;}} + {\rm{\;}}4.25{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}4.25{\rm{\;}} + {\rm{\;}}6.75{\rm{\;}} \times {\rm{\;}}4.25} \right)}}\)

⇒ ? = 2.5/100

⇒ ? = 0.025

∴ ? = 0.025

question: The sides of a triangle are 16 cm, 30 cm and 34 cm respectively. At each vertices, circles of radius 7 cm are drawn. What is the area of the triangle, excluding the portion covered by the sectors of the tringle? (π = 22/7)
question_hi: एक त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ क्रमशः 16 सेमी, 30 सेमी और 34 सेमी हैं। प्रत्येक शीर्ष पर, 7 सेमी त्रिज्या के वृत्त बनाये जाते हैं। वृत्त के क्षेत्रों द्वारा घेरे गए हिस्सों के अतिरिक्त, त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल क्या है? (π = 22/7)
solution:
Given,

⇒ s = (16 + 30 + 34)/2 = 80/2 = 40

Area of triangle = √(40(40 – 16)(40 – 30)(40 – 34))

= √57600 = 240 sq.cm

Area covered by sectors of circles = (180/360) × 22/7 × 7 × 7 = 77 sq.cm

Area of triangle Other than circles = 240 – 77 = 163 cm2
solution_hi:
दिया गया है,

⇒ s = (16 + 30 + 34)/2 = 80/2 = 40

त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल = √(40(40 – 16)(40 – 30)(40 – 34))

question: The average of 22 numbers is 52. The average of the first 8 numbers is 48 and the average of next 11 numbers is 54. The 20<sup>th</sup> number is 7 less than the 21<sup>st</sup> number and 21<sup>st</sup> number is 4 more than 22<sup>nd</sup> number. What is the average of the 20<sup>th</sup> and 22<sup>nd</sup> numbers?
question_hi: 22 संख्याओं का औसत 52 है। पहली 8 संख्याओं का औसत 48 है और अगली 11 संख्याओं का औसत 54 है। 20वीं संख्या 21वीं संख्या से 7 कम और 21वीं संख्या 22वीं संख्या से 4 अधिक है। 20वीं और 22वीं संख्याओं का औसत क्या है?
solution:
Total sum of 22 numbers = 22 × 52 = 1144

Total sum of first 8 numbers = 48 × 8 = 384

Total sum of next 11 numbers = 54 × 11 = 594

Total sum of last 3 numbers = 1144 – 384 – 594 = 166

Let 21st number be N.

⇒ N – 7 + N + N – 4 = 166

⇒ N = 59

⇒ 20th term = 59 – 7 = 52

⇒ 22nd term = 59 – 4 = 55

Required average = (52 + 55)/2 = 53.5

question: The radius of a cylinder in increased by 150% and its height is increased by 50%. What is the percentage increase in its volume?

solution:
Volume of cylinder = πr2h

New radius = r + r × 150/100 = 5r/2

New height = h + h × 50/100 = 3h/2

New volume = π(25r2/4)(3h/2) = (75/8)πr2h

Percentage change in volume = (75/8 – 1)/1 × 100 = 837.5%

question: If the seven digit number 56x34y4 is divisible by 72, then what is the least value of (x + y)?
question_hi: यदि सात अंकीय संख्या 56x34y4, 72 से विभाज्य है, तब (x + y) का न्यूनतम मान क्या है?
solution:
Factors of 72 = 8 × 9

The seven digit number = 56x34y4

As number should be divisible by 72 means should be divisible by 8 and 9.

It is divisible by 8 as its last 3 digits should be divisible by 8.

⇒ 4y4 = 424 is divisible by 8

For divisible by 9, it’s sum should be divisible by 9.

Then,

⇒ Sum = 5 + 6 + x + 3 + 4 + y + 4

= 22 + x + y

⇒ 22 + x + 2 = 24 + x

⇒ 24 + 3 = 27 is divisible by 9

Least value of (x + y) = 3 + 2 = 5
solution_hi:
72 के खंड = 8 × 9

सात अंकीय संख्या = 56x34y4

एक संख्या 72 से विभाज्य होनी चाहिए इसका अर्थ है वह संख्या 8 और 9 से भी विभाज्य है।

यह 8 से विभाज्य है क्योंकि इसके अंतिम 3 अंक 8 से विभाज्य हैं।

⇒ 4y4 = 424, 8 से विभाज्य है

9 से विभाज्य होने के लिए, इसका योग 9 से विभाज्य होना चाहिए।

तब,

⇒ योग = 5 + 6 + x + 3 + 4 + y + 4

= 22 + x + y

⇒ 22 + x + 2 = 24 + x

⇒ 24 + 3 = 27, 9 से विभाज्य है

(x + y) का न्यूनतम मान = 3 + 2 = 5

question: From the top of 75 m high tower, the angel of depression of two points P and Q on opposite side of the base of the tower on level ground is θ and ϕ, such that tanθ = 3/4 and tanϕ = 5/8. What is the distance between the points P and Q?

Thus, the distance between points P and Q

⇒ 120 + 100 = 220 m

∴ The correct answer is option (4).
